scientific_scope: The selected policy is conditional on one trained checkpoint. The new paired evaluation uses a fresh seed block and does not select models.

selection_rule.eligible: mixed BG128 s01, s02, and s03 with sealed 7 x 100 fixed stochastic u32 evaluations
selection_rule.holdouts_and_grade_swap: supporting evidence only; not used to rank checkpoints
selection_rule.primary: minimize mean frozen whole-shift joint cost on the 100 historical nominal slots
selection_rule.selection_data: previously observed common nominal evaluation slots
selection_rule.tie_break: training seed label in ascending order
